answer: Latency summit gating.** Each agent identity submits a small recurring heartbeat, and the relay records the shape of its inter-arrival timing over a rolling window. To pass, the median gap must sit below a strict latency summit and the variance must stay within a narrow band, while a random pigment marker is mixed into each heartbeat so replays fail. A new identity must also clear a willow-style ramp: several minutes of steady, jitter-bounded traffic before it gains full routing rights.
